about_the_game:
Synopsis

For three thousand years, she devoured a thousand human livers—
yet instead of becoming a divine being, the nine-tailed fox Kim Samwol awakens as a mere human.

Drifting into the city after centuries of wandering, she is saved by Park Jongman, the owner of a small café, and begins working there part-time.
However, when she learns that he possesses the rare “Emperor’s Fate,” essential for her ascension, Samwol faces an impossible choice:
Will she take his life to become immortal, or choose to live as a human in love?

DEMO Version Notes

  • In the opening menu, only Start Game and Exit options are available.

  • This demo version does not include character voice acting.

  • As this is an early development demo (ver.1), some animations and interactions may behave abnormally.

  • The character image for Kim Minwoo may display incorrectly due to a known issue.

  • The demo version is playable in Korean only.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM

short_description: A fantasy romance visual novel about Samwol, a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Experience her story of love, destiny, and choices in the human world, set in a cozy café. Featuring full voice acting, stunning illustrations, and immersive storytelling.
